starter_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent full-body character sprite for Ninja Maths, a five-year-old's offline puzzle game. The attached reference is the future powered-up art direction ONLY. Create her STARTER form: one friendly blonde little girl aged about five with warm brown eyes and tousled shoulder-length golden-blonde hair, same heroic red-and-gold palette, no hood covering hair and no mask. Simple crimson training tunic with small gold edging, dark leggings, simple brown/red ninja boots, a cloth belt, one plain wooden practice sword held downward away from her body in her right hand. Left hand relaxed at hip. Confident gentle smile. Charming polished hand-painted storybook fantasy game illustration, appealing round child proportions, beautifully shaded, clear silhouette and crisp readable shapes. Full body, three-quarter view facing slightly right, standing stable feet on same baseline, centered with generous clear space around the whole body and sword. No wings, lightning, armour or elaborate power effects yet. True transparent background, no scenery, ground plane, UI, captions, text, watermark or additional characters. This will be shown at 220 to 350 pixels tall, so face and equipment must read clearly. Keep the complete sprite fully inside the frame.
